title: Calculator Using Functions
description: Read two non-negative integers `a`, `b` and an operator `op` (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`) separated by spaces (e.g., `12 4 *`). Write separate functions for add, subtract, multiply, and integer division. For `/`, if `b == 0` print `Error`, otherwise print the integer quotient.
instructions: For `/`, if `b == 0` print `Error`, otherwise print integer quotient `Math.trunc(a / b)` / `int(a / b)`.
hints: Create four small functions: `add(a, b)`, `sub(a, b)`, `mul(a, b)`, `div(a, b)`.
Use `if / else if` on `op` to call the right function.

starterCode.python:
import sys
tokens = sys.stdin.read().split()
a, b, op = int(tokens[0]), int(tokens[1]), tokens[2]

def add(x, y): return x + y
def sub(x, y): return x - y
def mul(x, y): return x * y
